_comment: Optional: copy to <project>/.claude/stock-band.json. Every key has a default, so a partial file is fine.
_twSources_comment: Where Taiwan prices come from, in preference order - the band tries the first entry and falls through to the next when it has nothing fresh this tick. "yahoo" needs no setup, ~20 min behind. "shioaji" is 永豐's real-time feed; the band spawns scripts/fetch-quotes-shioaji.py itself (see the `shioaji` block below and references/quote-sources.md). This project file's default is ["yahoo"] alone - a source order and broker paths are a PERSONAL preference, not a project one, so put your own in ~/.claude/stock-band.json instead of here (it merges under this file: built-in defaults < ~/.claude/stock-band.json < this file). A legacy "twSource": "x" (a single string) still works as an alias for ["x"].
_shioaji_comment: Read only when "shioaji" is somewhere in twSources - normally that means it belongs in ~/.claude/stock-band.json, not here. `env` holds SINOBON_API_KEY/SINOBON_SECRET_KEY (never commit it); `~` expands to $HOME.
_holdings_comment: The 損益 view's manual alternative to stock-holdings.json (which wins for whichever market it names). qty is shares, not 張; cost is the average cost per share.
_holdingsSource_comment: "file" (default): the holdings file the broker script writes wins. "config": the holdings block above wins - use it to show a demo portfolio while the Taiwan route is a live brokerage.
_tw_comment: Taiwan 上櫃 symbols need "ex": "otc"; 上市 is the default. prevClose only matters for demo prices.
_futures_comment: Taiwan futures through a 永豐 futures account (see README's Taiwan futures (tf) section) - no built-in list and no 20-symbol cap. `code` is required; `name` is optional. Use a continuous alias (TXFR1 near month, TXFR2 next) to avoid re-editing this every settlement, or a specific month code (SRFJ6) to pin one expiry. An entry with no string code is dropped and logged.
